# Altered Audio Editor session schema

`session.schema.json` is copied unchanged from [Altered Audio Editor](https://github.com/geekcastradio/altered-audio-editor)
v0.38.0 (`schemas/session.schema.json`), © The GeekCast Radio Network, LLC, GPL-3.0-or-later.

Rolling's tests check every `.altaudio` session it makes against it. When Altered changes its session format, copy
the new schema here and run `npm test`.
